A deadly meningitis outbreak at the University of Kent In Canterbury is being treated as a "national incident" as the number of confirmed cases rises to 20. A 21-year-old university student and a pupil from a grammar school in Faversham have died while others have been hospitalized in what experts are calling a "super-spreader event," with several cases reportedly linked to a nightclub in Canterbury.
